layers.title: Dark matter: Planck CMB lensing
layers.license: TODO: redistribution license not verified; consult the original data provider.
layers.note: Planck lensing convergence: how much mass bends the CMB light on its way to us, summed along the line of sight. Most of that mass is dark matter. Orange = more mass than average, blue = less. Wiener-filtered and smoothed 1.5°, so only the large-scale pattern is real; grey is masked (Milky Way and point sources). Display resampling of order-3 HiPS Allsky where applicable, approximately 7 arcmin native samples; for orientation, not photometry. ICRS equirectangular, RA increases left, centre RA=180 deg.
